Book generation spans full-ups-v8 plus resumed v9; NFT generation is separate full-ups-v10. final-ups-v1 is a byte-exact derived union

Do not add nested CFC/key/endcap phase times to the containing total; all failures, protocol-independent waits and slow samples remain retained
One-second sampled process-family RSS includes shared pages and is not a physical peak or a sustained-memory conclusion
